analysis:

PORTFOLIO REVIEW:

• UHS (+3.48%): In screened list, uptrend basing. Thesis intact. Hold.

• FOXA (-2.11%): Not in today's screened list. Small loss but absence from screen is a yellow flag. Watch for deterioration.
• AMP (-9.70%, $9,387): This is the most urgent concern. AMP is ABSENT from the screened candidate list, which typically indicates a confirmed or borderline downtrend. Down nearly 10% from cost. If original stop was set at 1.5-2x ATR below entry (~$465-480 range), that level may be approaching or already breached. NEW TRADE ASSESSMENT: With 84% of equity deployed across 5 positions, only ~$10,078 of headroom remains. The 5-position cap is effectively full. Even if capacity existed, entering new longs in an SPY downtrend against an already-crowded book would be capital destruction, not capital compounding. The screened list has interesting names (TKO with +29% EPS revision and basing setup; HII defense at 15% 52w range; IR solid industrials) — but none warrant fighting market regime risk with sub-$10k sizing into a fully deployed book.

Sortino of -12.50 signals poor downside risk management historically. The correct response is NOT to add more positions to 'recover' — it is to tighten discipline, let stops do their job on AMP, and wait for a regime shift before redeploying.

RECOMMENDATION: Zero new trades. Hold cash. Review AMP stop urgently. If AMP is stopped out, do not immediately redeploy — bank the cash and wait for SPY to reclaim SMA50 before adding new exposure. Cash at 16% (rising to ~26% if AMP stops out) is an asset in this regime, not a drag.
